properties.name: The served hub skill names a local hub's declared dependencies as its list of designs, not the session's MCP configuration
properties.rationale: fact:root-cause-a-local-hubs-list-is-its-watch-manifest-but-the-hub-skill-names-the-mcp-config-and-no-pin-says-where-a-store-is-2026-10-02 measured that upstream_status reads a local hub's members from its declarations under --call, where there is no MCP configuration, while the skill said "That configuration is the list." Anthony accepted the wording fix on 2026-10-02 (fact:the-hub-address-book-idea-stays-open-and-the-hub-skill-wording-is-to-be-fixed-2026-10-02). That finding is NOT invalidated: its other half, that nothing records where each child's store is on this machine, stays open with dec:idea-a-hub-on-one-machine-can-say-where-each-tracked-design-is-reached-from-the-door. ver:the-served-text-asks-for-a-tracked-search-and-where-an-absence-was-checked does not cover this sentence: it is planned and its test file does not exist. The new served_skills.rs test was observed failing on main's served body.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Section 1 of the hub skill now says a local hub's list of designs is its declared dependencies (external_dependency), read back by upstream_status the same way through MCP and through --call; the MCP configuration only says which of them this session can open. Step 2.1 finds the designs from upstream_status.
